title: The first tick of a clock lasts too long
pause_note: v5, Your Brain Is Tricking You. DO hook: look at the dot, then jump to the ticking clock (stopped-clock illusion) in the first 3 s; wrong guess (the video lagged) killed at ~5 s; reveal (vision switched off during the eye jump) at ~8 s; the brain backfills the gap with the clock; up to half a second; three jumps a second; one-word question; loop.

beats: Look at the dot. Now jump your eyes to the clock.
That first tick seemed to hang. The video didn't lag.
While your eyes jump, your brain switches off the blurry view.
Then it fills the gap with the clock, as if you'd been looking all along.
That borrowed time lands on the first tick. It can feel up to half a second longer.
And your eyes jump about three times a second.
